## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 128 captures during July 2021. The activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. This did not prevent the scheduled work from being completed or affect the overall recording of activity.

The monthly capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. Results are reported below using the recorded activity for the site and month.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. Of the 128 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.3 per cent. These captures could not be used for grading, and the result should continue to be monitored through routine site review.

## Grading

Grading identified 24 referable results from the monthly activity. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This provides an overview of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process. Together, the referable result and the median lag support routine operational monitoring of the service. Further review should continue through the usual quality and performance arrangements, with attention to ungradable images and grading timeliness.
